text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 106 January 24, 1973
DECLARING AS FINAL AND BINDING THE DECISIONS OF THE NATIONAL HISTORICAL
COMMISSION ON THE NAMING AND RENAMING OF HISTORICAL EDIFICES AND LANDMARKS
By virtue of the powers vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of
the Philippines, and pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081 dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1
dated September 22, 1972, do hereby decree as final and binding all decisions of the National Historical
Commission on the naming and renaming of historical edifices and landmarks: Provided, That its decision
with respect to the naming and renaming of streets and plazas shall be recommendatory.
All provisions of laws, executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.
This Decree is hereby made part of the laws of the land and shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
